thread:
nora (DevEx): quick heads-up — scheduled SDK patch publish tonight 02:00 UTC: py/ts 0.12.1. Patch fixes Python checksum validation, TS typing tweak. Plan: canary -> smoke -> flip 'latest'. Any immediate concerns?

liam (Release): ack. main checklist: canary smoke green, signature/checksum validation, docs staged. If we see checksum/hash mismatch on pip/npm installs, abort flip and follow rollback runbook.

jo (QA): running canaries now on staging. Initial note: pip install on ubuntu runner popped a checksum mismatch on the wheel (hash verification failed). Trying to reproduce locally.

nora (DevEx): thanks. please paste the exact error and the hashes. we'll want the wheel binary and the uploader metadata.

publish-bot: ci-publish-1755559950 requested by @nora. job queued.

publish-bot: ci-publish-1755559950: python wheel uploaded to s3://releases/0.12.1/wheel.whl; npm package uploaded to registry.

publish-bot: ci-publish-1755559950: post-upload verification: PY_WHEEL SHA512 expected=SHA512:eeff...001, observed=SHA512:77aa...f2b. VERIFICATION FAILED.

liam (Release): HOLD flip. Do not update dist-tags. This smells like non-deterministic packaging (gzip levels/mtime). We'll treat as a blocker.

jo (QA): reproduced locally: `pip install --no-cache-dir package==0.12.1` fails with "HASH MISMATCH". Attached two hash outputs: builder-host hash and uploader hash. Different.

ana (typo) -- correction by ana (Docs): ana (Docs): tagging docs hold too — I'll mark the release notes as "publish pending" and add a line explaining the hold for transparency.

nora (DevEx): action items: (1) don't flip tags; (2) collect artifact binaries from builders A/B and compare; (3) run hermetic build on approved runner; (4) re-publish from verified runner only. Liam, I'll open an incident for packaging nondeterminism.

publish-bot: debug output: builder=builder-12; uploader=release-runner-3; builder-hash=SHA512:77aa...f2b; uploader-hash=SHA512:eeff...001.

jo (QA): binary diffs show gzip header differs (mtime). We should normalize timestamps in wheel builds. I can push a small patch to the build script to set `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` and rebuild.

liam (Release): good find. Plan: revert npm dist tag 'latest' -> 0.12.0 now to avoid accidental pulls, and hold PyPI exposure (can't unpublish easily). We'll republish after hermetic build.

publish-bot: ci-unset-dist-1755560001: unsetting npm 'latest' -> now points to 0.12.0. (actioned by @publish-bot) :white_check_mark:

ana (typo again) — ana (Docs): updated release notes draft: "Release held due to packaging checksum mismatch; republish pending. Users on pip/npm unaffected if pinned to 0.12.0." Will keep PR open.

nora (DevEx): created incident INF-2026-112: "build nondeterminism - wheel checksum mismatch" and pinged @eng-runtime @eng-infra @security. Link: https://redwood/in/INF-2026-112 (internal).

jo (QA): hermetic build on builder-2 completed with `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` set. New wheel hash = SHA512:eeff...001 which matches uploader-expected. Smoke tests on that artifact passed (linux, macos, windows).

publish-bot: ci-publish-rebuild-1755561800: republish from release-runner-2 started...

publish-bot: ci-publish-rebuild-1755561800: uploads completed; signature and checksum verified. verification=OK.

liam (Release): all gating criteria satisfied. Plan to flip dist-tags in 10m: npm 'latest' -> 0.12.1, npm 'legacy' stays pinned at 0.11.x; PyPI index metadata will reference 0.12.1 as newest. I'll wait 10m for final thumbs.

ana (ana) correction — ana (Docs): docs: added small transparent note in changelog and a migration snippet. Will publish docs after flip.

nora (DevEx): thumbs up from me. Also pushing a follow-up PR to the release pipeline to normalize wheel timestamps and enforce reproducible builds.

publish-bot: dist-tag update queued: ci-update-dist-1755563000.

publish-bot: ci-update-dist-1755563000: npm 'latest' -> 0.12.1. npm 'legacy' -> 0.11.x. PyPI: metadata updated (no deletions).

liam (Release): flip completed. Monitoring for any downstream issues for the next hour.

jo (QA): smoke loop running. All good so far. no more checksum complaints.

nora (DevEx): closing loop: incident updated with RCA notes and PR link to make builds hermetic. Thanks all for quick turn. :heart:
